biggest_catch: Only about 2% of applicants are accepted — and project pricing is set by averaging expert estimates, not by your rate alone.
catches: Extremely selective — only about the top 2% of applicants are accepted.
No bidding wars, but pricing power is capped: the price is the average of experts' estimates, not your rate alone.
28-day bug-fix warranty means free rework if scoped bugs resurface.
Escrow release depends on the client marking the project complete.

c1.evidence: Codeable's own site states: 'a client posts a project brief and is matched with a small group of pre-vetted experts' and 'Only the top 2% of applicants make it in' — a real, public expert-matching marketplace.

c2.evidence: Official page states clients pay typical market rates of $80–$120/hour, but expert net pay is not disclosed as a fixed provider range — framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: apply, pass vetting, get matched to briefs, estimate, escrow-funded work, paid on completion.

c4.evidence: Applying and working as an expert requires no upfront fee; vetting is merit-based.

eligibility: Expert WordPress developers who can pass code review, a live coding test, and a trial period.
notes: Scenario: dev niche (WordPress). Codeable is a vetted WordPress-expert network: clients post briefs, matched experts scope and estimate, and paid work runs through escrow. Highly selective; income is per-project and variable — never guaranteed.
numeric_basis: payout: per-project expert net pay, no official fixed provider range. time: 60 min of billable work to earn one hour's pay, up to 120 min including scoping/admin overhead.
payout_quote: Once the scope is defined, the platform's algorithm calculates a single fixed price based on the average of the experts' estimates.
payout_value_note: Codeable states clients typically pay market rates of $80–$120/hour; expert net payout is set per project (average of expert estimates) and no official fixed provider pay range is disclosed.

steps: Apply as a WordPress expert — multi-stage vetting: portfolio/code review, behavioral interview, live coding test, and trial period (top ~2% accepted).
Get matched to client project briefs in small expert groups; collaborate in a shared workroom to scope requirements.
Submit your estimate; Codeable sets a single fixed price from the average of the experts' estimates.
Start after the client deposits funds in escrow; payment releases when the client marks the project complete (28-day bug-fix warranty applies).
timing: Clients get matched with experts within about 24 hours of posting a brief; escrow releases on client approval.
